abstract: We treated 542 patients with trophoblastic diseases from 1965 through 1988, and succeeded in preserving fertility in 269 of them (240 cases of invasive mole and 29 cases of choriocarcinoma). Of the 269 patients, 198 (79.5%) conceived after completing treatment. A total of 396 pregnancies in these women resulted in 295 term live births (74.5%), 51 spontaneous abortions (12.9%), and 4 recurrences of moles (1.0%). Four cases (1.32%) of malformations were discovered. The growth conditions of 101 children born in 1976 or later were followed up until the age of 18 months. Their heights or weights did not differ significantly from those of children measured in national infantile-growth surveys. The psychoneurological development of 54 children up to the age of 7 years who were studied by using infantile mental-development questionnaires showed no marked mental retardation. Our results provide strong evidence of the safety of chemotherapy for the treatment of trophoblastic diseases.
abstract_ja: 当科では1965年から1988年の間に絨毛性疾患の患者542例を治療し、269例で妊孕性を温存できた(侵入奇胎240例、絨毛癌29例)。269例のうち198例(79.5%)が治療終了後に妊娠した。これらの女性の計396回の妊娠では、295例の正期産生児(74.5%)、51例の自然流産(12.9%)、4例の奇胎再発(1.0%)が生じた。奇形は4例(1.32%)で認められた。1976年以降に出生した101名の児について、18か月齢まで発育状況を追跡した。身長および体重は、全国の乳児発育調査による児の値と有意差がなかった。乳児精神発達質問票を用いて、7歳までの54名の児の精神神経発達を調べたところ、著明な精神発達遅滞は認められなかった。本研究の結果は、絨毛性疾患の治療における化学療法の安全性を強く示すものである。
